entities.title: Tools by language
entities.summary: The tools' source, grouped by language, and the release scripts.
entities.purpose: Groups the Rust workspace (rust/), the zazzle C invoker (c/), the .NET tool zazzle-csharp-indexer (dotnet/) and the release scripts (release/). The folder is named for the tools' primary platform: zazzle, zazzled, zazzle-csharp-indexer and agent-fs also build and run on Linux.
boundaries: A grouping folder: it has no code of its own. How the tools in it use each other is in the repository's folder record.
